text:
Alice Mendez: pager triggered — multiple 503s from HF model registry during cold starts, seeing fetch failures for rtx-small and rtx-medium. impact: new instance cold starts failing (~25-40% errors).
SRE-Bot: INCIDENT CREATED - sev2 - hf-hosting-rate-limit (2061234567) :pager:. Auto-page sent to oncall.
PagerDuty Bot: Paging oncall: @Ravi_Patel (oncall) — escalation policy applied.
Ravi Patel: on it, joining. can someone share rough error surface?
Jun Li: logs show repetitive 429/503 from huggingface-artifacts.s3 region us-east-1. sample:```
2026-03-15T10:02:12Z fetch_model model=rtx-small status=429 retry-after=2
2026-03-15T10:02:14Z fetch_model model=rtx-small status=503
```
Maria Gomez: customer reports: slow startup + 5m timeouts for new sessions. Prod error budget seeing spike for startup-latency route.
Ravi Patel: rolling mitigation plan: 1) enable local cache fallback for recently used models 2) increase backoff and jitter 3) route fetches to mirror registry if mirror healthy.
Alice Mendez: mirror exists in /hf-mirror-us via our CDN. Jun, can you validate mirror integrity for rtx-small?
Jun Li: doing quick diff, seems mirror has v1.3 of rtx-small but missing some shard_7 artifacts. will try rehydrate.
HF Status Bot: Hugging Face status: Elevated API rate limits in region us-east-1 — engineering investigating. https://status.huggingface.co/incident/abc123
Ravi Patel: switching prefetch policy: set aggressive prefetch for top-20 models to avoid on-demand cold starts for 10m. Patching config now.```
`/deploy rollouts set prefetch.top=20 prefetch.window=600s --env=prod`
Maria Gomez: notifying CS: ticket template updated with "HF artifact rate limits causing cold starts; using mirror & prefetch as mitigation".
Alice Mendez: start customer-impact tally: number of distinct customers affected ~12, top two enterprise customers showing 1-2% of requests failing to start. No data exfiltration.
Jun Li: rehydration started, pushing missing shard_7 to mirror via s3-copy. ETA ~8m.
Ravi Patel: increased client-side retry with exponential backoff (base 500ms, max 10s), added jitter. pushing config.
SRE-Bot: CONFIG CHANGE APPLIED by ravi.patel: prefetch.top=20, backoff.base_ms=500, backoff.max_ms=10000.
Maria Gomez: can we do a quick canary to confirm reduced errors for cold starts? Recommend 10% traffic route to prefetch-enabled fleet.
Ravi Patel: canary started at 10:20 UTC, routing 10% of new traffic to prefetch fleet. monitoring error rate.
Jun Li: mirror rehydration complete for rtx-small and rtx-medium. verified checksums.
Alice Mendez: initial observation: canary cold-start 503s down from ~35% to ~4%, overall platform cold-start error down ~60%. good.
Ravi Patel: contacting HF support channel with request id and logs, asking for rate limit lift. message sent.```
"`Support request: POST /support with logs and incident id 2061234567`
HF Status Bot: Update: HF engineering applied rate limit rule adjustment for affected artifact endpoints. ETA for full recovery unknown.
Maria Gomez: update customers: sent status note to 12 affected customers, included mitigation steps & timeframe.
Ravi Patel: preparing handoff to night oncall — @Jun_Li will take first responder for follow-ups, I'll stay for 20m overlap.
Jun Li: acknowledged, will monitor dashboards and HF status page. setting alert for artifact-429 spikes >10/min.
SRE-Bot: HANDOFF created: from ravi.patel to jun.li at 2061234987.
Alice Mendez: post-incident actions: 1) add mirror coverage tests for all top-50 models 2) add pre-warm policy for enterprise customers above threshold 3) run tabletop with HF dependency team. Assign owners?
Ravi Patel: I'll own #2, Jun will own #1, Maria will coordinate customer comms and tabletop invites.
Maria Gomez: noted, creating follow-up tickets and calendar invites now.
Ravi Patel: closing incident channel in 15m if no regression. thanks team. :thumbsup:
HF Status Bot: Incident resolved for affected endpoint; HF monitoring shows normalized request success rates.
Alice Mendez: incident closed — severity degraded to sev4. write-up required for postmortem.
Maria Gomez: filing postmortem draft, will include timeline, mitigations, and follow-ups.
SRE-Bot: INCIDENT CLOSED - hf-hosting-rate-limit (2061234567).
